sloka: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवो वाहिनी पतिः ।प्रहर्षम् अतुलम् लेभे साधु साध्विति च अब्रवीत् ॥४-८-२५॥
transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā sugrīvo vāhinī patiḥ ।praharṣam atulam lebhe sādhu sādhviti ca abravīt ॥4-8-25॥

translations.english: On hearing Rama's words, Sugriva, chief of the army of monkeys experienced immeasurable happiness and exclaimed, 'you're great, you're great.'
